title: An album diary for yourself and your friends
description: Personal notes and a chosen history help people come back to music.

blocks.text: Listening leaves an impression that a play count does not always express. A short note preserves the reason to come back to an album.

quote.text: Ive tried a bunch of apps/forums like this but they were all severely lacking. Echo meets all my needs and then some. It’s the only social media I really keep up with and I’ve found the community there to be really wholesome and supportive.

blocks.text: Let people keep a diary, mark the recordings they choose and share individual notes. Show clearly how complete the automatically collected history is.
Do not promise flawless tracking across every service. A private entry has to stay private until the person chooses to publish it.
